question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(D\) and \(E\) lie on \(AB\) and \(AC\), respectively, and \(DE\parallel BC\). Which of the following proportions is incorrect?
solution: When \(DE\parallel BC\), \(DE/BC=AD/AB\) (\(\triangle ADE\sim\triangle ABC\)), rather than \(AD/DB\), so D is incorrect. A, B, and C are all correct proportions.
